note: Counts come from the fixture: Value matches all four variables, of which scb/example's value and second are held, reference is unheld and sos/unheld is unheld; for 'Example reference' the register name supplies 'example' and only the reference variable's own text supplies 'reference'. Fails if the facet drifts from the variable arm's matching: holdings counting an unheld variable or dropping a held one, reference dropping an unheld register, or the multi-token register-context admission being skipped (0 rows) or loosened to any token (3 in scb/example, 1 in sos/unheld).
